answer: ClinicalTrials.gov records trial-level and arm-level results, but it does not provide a comparable registry field for "works better" across drugs. Sponsors define different endpoints, analysis windows, and units for melanoma studies, so efficacy cannot be aggregated into a fair head-to-head comparison from the registry alone.
